tagline: Aries starts things faster than you can admire them, then hands you the aftermath, which always arrives later and at greater volume than expected.
overview: Aries is the first sign of the zodiac, and behaves like it: the whole personality is a first move. Cardinal fire, ruled by Mars, the Ram, an animal that decides where to go and then goes. You tend to trust instinct over deliberation, and you are right often enough that the habit never gets examined. What reads as nerve from the outside is usually a shortcut through a decision most people would spend a week on.

The real Aries signature is not the launch but the morning after. This is the sign most likely to start a business, a fight, a fitness regime and a correspondence, and least likely to be the person still answering in month four. Interest in Aries tracks the adrenaline of the opening, not the accumulating value of the middle, and boredom is the true enemy, not fear and not failure. Aries is remarkably good at recovering from wreckage. It is less good at not making it.

Socially, Aries gets to be known quickly, which is a genuine advantage and a real cost. Within an hour a room has a version of you: warm, funny, certain, slightly loud, and entirely untroubled by the need to be liked. Nobody spends a year deciding whether you are interesting. The cost is that being legible is not the same as being known, and that a personality this fast needs a long horizon, a practice, or a partner, to keep it from flattening into repetition.
callout_text: An Aries breaks the deadlock by committing, and then has to live in the country they just made.
traits_lede: Every Aries strength and weakness is the same gear running at two speeds: fast start, no second gear. At full throttle that reads as nerve, and at a standstill it reads as carelessness.
strengths: Decisive — Ends debates in one line, and moves before consensus would have finished forming.
Direct — Says the useful thing plainly, usually before deciding whether it will be received.
Fearless in motion — Enters the room, the pitch, the argument that everyone else declined.
Resilient — Recovers fast from a loss, and doesn't need anyone to confirm the recovery.
Cheap to restart — Treats a fresh attempt as a normal event, not an admission of failure.
weaknesses: Impatient with process — Abandons the necessary middle of any task, not just the boring one.
Follows through reluctantly — Finishes what's already interesting, and resents the rest of the list.
Temper arrives early — Anger shows up instantly and clears slowly, often after the issue is gone.
Poor at delegating — Would rather do it badly now than trust someone with it later.
Blunt when tired — Treats tact as a luxury on days when it is actually a requirement.
love_lede: Aries falls early and describes the falling in action rather than words. The seduction is availability in the present tense: you are genuinely all there, and then genuinely elsewhere.
love: Aries courts the way other signs hesitate: directly, with an actual plan and a real appetite. There is the long drive that starts at midnight, the gesture made before the conversation, the flat declaration nobody has to translate. It is disarming because it skips the negotiation phase, and it works on people tired of being pursued indirectly. Trouble begins when the mystery is resolved. Once the other person is understood, attention wanders to the next open question, and a partner may feel a door close without a sound.

What Aries needs in love is a person who is not a project. Loyalty matters more than romance, low drama matters more than intensity, and a partner with an interior life that does not require managing matters more than almost anything else. Arguments, when they come, are short and usually survivable, because Aries would rather resolve than accumulate. The exception is respect, which is never forgiven quickly. The work of the long relationship is converting intensity into duration, which is a duller virtue and the only one that works.
friends: Aries friendships run at high velocity and skip the subtle part. You organize things, arrive first, and are usually the one who texts, which makes you the friend everyone keeps. Loyalty in a crisis is not something Aries has to work at; you show up with a car, a plan, and no interest in discussing it afterwards. A slow Tuesday with no purpose is the harder test, and Aries tends to treat it as an opportunity for a plan.

The difficulty is that Aries friendships are loud in affection and unreliable in administration. You cancel, you reschedule, you arrive with tremendous energy and a completely different idea of what the evening is for. This reads as selfishness to the more punctual signs and usually isn't. The friendships that last are the ones where you found something worth repeating, and where somebody else held the calendar while you held the enthusiasm.
career: Aries belongs wherever the decision has to be made before the information is complete: the pitch, the launch, the emergency, the interview, the first day of a company nobody believed in. Feedback that arrives the same day is fuel, and a visible score is close to a requirement, because without one you have to invent your own. The trap is any organization that runs on committees, consensus, and a review cycle measured in quarters.

Money is spent in bursts and on equipment, travel, generosity, and the visible proof that something is now happening. Career-wise the deciding question is durability: not whether the work matters to you but whether it will still be there in six years without supervision. Aries is unusually good at starting a career and unusually bad at the ninth month of one. The remedy is dull and effective: choose a track with a real learning curve, find one person worth working under, and make the boring commitment on purpose.
man: You announce yourself before you have decided anything, and the announcement is often correct. Confidence in Aries men is not performed so much as structural: you approach first, speak plainly, and treat reluctance in someone else as a puzzle rather than a verdict. The dark side is that certainty arrives faster than information, which can make you mistake your first read of a situation for the situation itself.

In love you are direct to the edge of rudeness and loyal past the point of reason. You are at your best in the opening phase, when everything is still a decision, and you need a partner who is not confused by that energy. A relationship with an Aries man requires saying out loud what you actually want, because he will not guess and will not slow down to be asked twice.
woman: An Aries woman tends to lead by starting things rather than by claiming authority, and she is more comfortable with motion than with hierarchy. The drive reads as attractive until it reads as impatience, and those are the same behavior with different company. What she needs from a partner is not admiration exactly, but someone who treats her directness as information rather than as a mood.

The difficulty in relationships is that she says the true thing first, then cannot understand why the other person is still hurt an hour later. She experiences the moment as complete; other people are still in it. Learning that a repair can take longer than an apology is the whole education, and it is more useful to her than any amount of patience from the other side.

faq.a: Aries runs roughly from March 21 to April 19, though the exact span shifts each year. The Sun changes sign at a precise astronomical moment, not at midnight, and because the tropical zodiac is measured against the equinox, that moment can fall about 18 hours earlier or later from year to year. If your birthday sits near the boundary, the time you were born decides the sign, and a chart calculator will settle it.

faq.q: What is Aries' element and modality?
faq.a: Aries is fire and cardinal, ruled by Mars. Fire gives it speed, heat and impatience; cardinal makes it a starter rather than a sustainer, so Aries begins seasons and enterprises. The combination produces someone who acts first and reflects later. Mars as ruler adds physical courage, competitiveness and a low tolerance for being pushed, and the cardinal fire is why the sign is at its brightest at the very start of a cycle. Its traditional gemstone is the diamond.

faq.q: Who is Aries most compatible with?
faq.a: Leo, Sagittarius and Aquarius are the easiest fits. Leo shares the fire and never mistakes your pace for arrogance, Sagittarius supplies the momentum without competing for the wheel, and Aquarius will let you be intense without asking you to justify it. Libra, the opposite sign, is the hardest relationship in the zodiac for an Aries, because Libra wants the negotiation you tend to skip and it also wants your attention for longer stretches.

faq.q: How do I know if I'm really an Aries?
faq.a: Look at how you behave when something is undecided. Aries is the person who speaks first, makes the call, starts the thing while everyone is still discussing it, and loses interest around the point where maintenance begins. If your pattern is bursts of hard effort followed by restlessness, the Sun sign is describing something real. If you are patient, diplomatic and happy to wait for a process, the Aries label fits your birthday and not your temperament.

faq.q: Why do Aries lose interest so quickly?
faq.a: Because Aries is drawn to the resistance of a problem, not to the problem itself. Once the obstacle is resolved the reward is largely spent, and what remains produces no sensation at all. Sticking power comes from attaching yourself deliberately to the second phase, usually with company, because solitude in the middle is where Aries evaporates.

faq.q: What is the Aries blind spot at work?
faq.a: It is the assumption that the hard part is the decision, when in most organizations the hard part is the fourth month. Aries is genuinely good at the first ninety days and quietly poor at the year, because the year contains no new information. The blind spot is also relational: you often read a quiet colleague as a slow colleague, when what you are actually seeing is someone processing rather than objecting.
